summary: The registrant, The Metals Royalty Company Inc., filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of a 1.0% index-priced gross overriding production royalty on the Mesabi Metallics iron ore project for total consideration of $132.5 million (including $7.5 million in shares). The company also exercised an option to acquire an additional 1.0% royalty on the same terms, which if completed by July 31, 2026 would double the royalty to 2.0%. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The transaction establishes near-term royalty cash flow from a tier-1 DR-grade iron ore project in the U.S., with commissioning expected in H2 2026. Watch for the funding of the additional royalty and commissioning milestones.
